name: @carshenas/locale
description: The Persian text, number, money and calendar rules the web app and the worker share (ADR-0014): the locale constants, digits in any script, reading amounts and Solar Hijri dates as Farsi pages write them, and writing them: tomans, counts, percentages, Jalali dates, isolates for plain text. Pure TypeScript source, run as is by Next.js, in the browser and by Node.
